watches.name: Viajero SE
watches.description: Viajero SE: Special Edition (or Swiss Edition) is the answer when we asked ourselves "if we could elevate Viajero, what would we do?" This stunning timepiece boasts a wealth of features and craftsmanship and can be ranked with some of the best in Horology. Viajero SE is our first Swiss Made timepiece that showcases a refined, hand-finished stainless steel case characterized by a polished heavy finish, complemented by brushed detailing on the bezel to achieve a minimalist aesthetic that directs attention to the dial, the true focal point of the timepiece. Viajero SE features an updated city bezel that is more inclusive to the global masses. Boasting an exhibition caseback and a distinctive Atlas-shaped rotor, Viajero SE is a testament to meticulous craftsmanship and attention to detail. Available in three dial variants - "Antique Cobalt," "Grayscale," and "Polyglot" - each design features hand drawn 17th Century maps on Grand Feu Enamel dials that capture attention. With a case diameter of 39.5mm and a lug width of 20mm, Viajero SE strikes a balance between presence and wearability, standing at 10mm tall to offer visual depth without excessive bulk. Crafted for travelers, geography enthusiasts, or those seeking a captivating conversation piece, Viajero SE continues where we left off, making global timekeeping approachable by all.

watches.name: Annum
watches.description: Annum - A New Chapter in Time Derived from the Latin word for "year," Annum marks a significant evolution in both design and mechanical innovation. As the second complication-based timepiece from Haim Watch Company , Annum introduces our inaugural custom mechanical calendar module - an elegant Complete Calendar with Moonphase - and proudly debuts our second customized movement, Caliber HWC-2 . This model represents a confluence of heritage and progress. The Complete Calendar complication with Moonphase is powered by a custom mechanical module - an achievement that underscores our deepening technical capabilities and continued pursuit of horological excellence. The dial design draws inspiration from the rich legacy of vintage watchmaking, reinterpreted through a refined neo-vintage aesthetic. Available in three sophisticated colorways - Dark Cobalt, Stone White, and Fumée - each dial is meticulously finished, with two variants showcasing intricate CNC guilloché patterns, offering a textured interplay of light and depth. Applied hour markers and gracefully sculpted leaf-style hands complete the dial, enhancing its timeless elegance. Crafted in brushed and polished stainless steel , Annum features an updated take on our signature vintage-inspired lugs. The 38mm case and 20mm lug width deliver a harmonious profile on the wrist, while the exhibition caseback reveals the finely decorated movement within - an invitation to appreciate the artistry behind the function. Annum is paired with a bespoke French Epsom leather strap , complete with quick-release spring bars and a signed buckle: blending effortless wearability with elevated style. Annum is more than a timepiece - it is our celebration of modern refinement rooted in classical tradition. Bold yet approachable, it represents a defining moment in our journey.

watches.name: Legacy Automatic: Azure
watches.description: Legacy Automatic: Azure The second to last iteration of the Legacy Automatic series. Azure features a stunning Baby Blue dial with applied Breguet Numerals and accents - which include the seconds track, an updated 6 o'clock date window with a color matched date disc and a captivating Guilloche center. Legacy Automatic: Azure is cased in hand finished Titanium and is 38mm, powered by Caliber HWC-1. The case features a coin edge bezel and hollowed lugs. Azure comes paired with a sand colored handmade French Epsom Leather strap. Azure is limited to 25 pieces, with each caseback individually numbered. CONUS shipping included. Note that serial number selection will not be available for this release.

watches.description: Presenting our latest Milanese Bracelet. Elevate the aesthetic of your Haim Watch Co. timepiece with our new vintage inspired Milanese bracelet. Thicker, more textured and more detailed than our first generation bracelet, It is sleek, stylish and adjustable to all wrist sizes. Designed to fit any watch with a 20mm lug width. It features quick release technology with our logo engraved on the buckle.

watches.name: Viajero
watches.description: *NOTE* Next expected Viajero restock is Feb/March 2027. Please join our mailing list to be notified first. Viajero , which translates to "Traveler" in Spanish, represents our inaugural Worldtimer design in our catalog. This stunning timepiece boasts a wealth of features and craftsmanship, made approachable by all. Viajero showcases a redesigned, hand-finished stainless steel case characterized by a polished heavy finish, complemented by brushed detailing on the bezel to achieve a minimalist aesthetic that directs attention to the dial - the true focal point of the timepiece, created from a 3D relief. Boasting an exhibition caseback with a distinctive Atlas-shaped rotor, the Viajero is a testament to meticulous craftsmanship and attention to detail. Available in four dial variants inspired by different modes of travel – "Air", "Land", "Water" and "Aerodrome" ( which is our ode to airports) – each design pays homage to various aspects of exploration and adventure. With a case diameter of 38.5mm and a lug width of 20mm, the Viajero strikes a balance between presence and wearability, standing at 12mm tall to offer visual depth without excessive bulk. Crafted for travelers, geography enthusiasts, or those seeking a captivating conversation piece, the Viajero introduces the coveted "Worldtimer" complication to all audiences, making global timekeeping accessible and stylish for all.

watches.name: L2 Chronograph
watches.description: T he L2 Chronograph is the second generation of the Legacy Chronograph family. The L2’s design is intended to catch your eye immediately. It’s a watch you’ll catch yourself staring at, even without needing to tell the time. The L2 is made to stand out with four dial themes and a newly designed case that seamlessly blends brushed and polished surfaces along with plenty of chamfered edges. Powered by the VK64 caliber for ease of use and more accurate timekeeping, the Haim Watch Company L2 is where aesthetics and precision intersect.

watches.name: Legacy Automatic
watches.description: The Legacy Automatic is the first time and date only design of our “Legacy” lineup. It includes many firsts for the brand, including our first custom designed caliber and is also 100% US assembled, including the movement! Your watch will be built just for you, so the memories begin the moment you order yours! The Legacy Automatic features a newly designed, hand-finished, titanium case with a subtle coin edge bezel, hollowed lugs and an exhibition caseback. It is available in three dial variants for now: “Dark Cobalt”, “Burgundy Tux”, and our first ever Aventurine dial “Stargazer”. Each dial is limited to 50 pieces. The case is 38mm with a 20mm lug width. The Legacy Automatic is also 10.5mm tall, so it easily fits under a shirt cuff while allowing visual depth to the dial. The Legacy Automatic is made to “create memories and celebrate milestones”; which can often get overlooked in the world of watch collecting, when current trajectories have been more hype based.

watches.name: Descent
watches.description: Designed to be elegant while ready for the elements. Descent is not your typical timepiece. The Descent is a refreshing take on a Sports Watch that blends the right amount of classic dress style and a rugged sports build with aesthetic dial finishes. It’s a design that is unapologetically original. The Descent features the proprietary “Duo-Bezel”, combining the functions of both a 60 minute timer and a GMT on the brushed steel rotational bezel. It also has 200m of water resistance, so it's ready to go wherever you are.
